"THIGHS and WINGS"
Day: 9 Wednesday 10-09-24

Warm Up: Hit up 5 or more of your lifting buddies to meet you for some LEGs and BACK Strength Training.

1. a. BACK SQUAT 5 sets of 5 reps @ 70%
super set
b. STRICT Pull Ups 5 sets of 2-5 reps
2½ min rest between each super set
* Full range of Motion*

2. a. DB REVERSE LUNGES 3 sets of 5 reps
super set
b. BB BENT OVER ROW 3 sets of 10 reps
2 min rest between each superset

Cardio
super set
a. ONE Arm DB Row
3x 10 reps each arm
b. DB/or KB Farmers walk
3 sets of 40 yards
90 sec rest between each superset

Recovery
30 min Walk
Pulled Pork Sandwiches
Mac and Cheese
8+ hrs of sleep

"Day 9: Thighs and Wings"
Warm up: Hit up 5 or more of your lifting buddies to meet you for some legs and back strength training.
1. a. Back Squat 5 sets of 5 reps @ 70%
super set b. Strict Pull Ups 5 sets of 2-5 reps
* Full range of motion
rest 2:30 between each super set
2. a. Dumbbell Reverse Lunges 3 sets of 5 reps
super set b. Barbell Bent Over Row 3 sets of 10 reps
rest 2:00 between each super set
3. a. One Arm Dumbbell Row 3 sets of 10 reps
* Each arm
super set b. Dumbbell or Kettlebell Farmers Walk 3 sets
* 40 yards
rest 1:30 between each super set
Recovery: 30 min Walk · Pulled Pork Sandwiches · Mac and Cheese · 8+ hrs of sleep
